content.title: 2025-26 College Football Playoff schedule, dates, TV channel, sites
content.text: Here's the schedule for the 2025-26 College Football Playoff. This is the second year the CFP is using a 12-team format. The bracket and matchups were announced on Sunday, Dec. 7. BRACKET GAME: Check your picks in the College Football Bracket Challenge Game Games are Dec. 19, 2025 to Jan. 19, 2026, with the first round on Dec. 19-20, quarterfinals on Dec. 31-Jan. 1, semifinals on Jan. 8-9 and finally the CFP National Championship Game on Monday, Jan. 19, 2026, in Miami Gardens, Fla. Check out the full schedule below. 2025-26 College Football Playoff schedule, scores Click or tap here for a live scoreboard First round (Dec. 19-20) Friday, Dec. 19 No. 9 Alabama 34, No. 8 Oklahoma 24 Saturday, Dec. 20: No. 10 Miami (Fla.) 10, No. 7 Texas A&M 3 No. 6 Ole Miss 41, No. 11 Tulane, 10 No. 5 Oregon 51, No. 12 James Madison 34 Quarterfinals (Dec. 31-Jan. 1) Wednesday, Dec. 31 No. 10 Miami (Fla.) 24, No. 2 Ohio State 14 Thursday, Jan. 1 No. 5 Oregon 23, No. 4 Texas Tech 0 No. 1 Indiana 38, No. 9 Alabama 3 No. 6 Ole Miss 39, No. 3 Georgia 34 Semifinals (Jan. 8-9) Thursday, Jan. 8 No. 10 Miami (Fla.) 31, No. 6 Ole Miss 27 | Fiesta Bowl (Glendale, AZ) Friday, Jan. 9 No. 1 Indiana 56, No. 5 Oregon 22 | Peach Bowl (Atlanta) College Football Playoff National Championship Game Monday, Jan. 19 No. 1 Indiana 27, No. 10 Miami (Fla.) 21 🏆 Indiana wins the 2025 College Football Playoff national championship Here is the history of the College Football Playoff national championship game.
